CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Gunung Mas Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of Gunung Mas.

4 - 4 . Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.

5. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
6. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from Violence and discrimination.
7. Woman is a person who is female.
8. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb.

9. Community is an individual, community group, including parents and family.

10. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against Women and Children.
11. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA, is a coordination forum for handling victims of Violence against Women and Children which is organized in tiers at the regency and sub-district levels.
13. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower Women in various fields of development, as well as protection of Women and Children from various types of discrimination, and acts of Violence, including trafficking in persons established by the government or community-based.
14. Child-Friendly Village/Sub-District, hereinafter abbreviated as K/DRA, is the development of a village/sub-district area that unites the commitment and resources of the village/sub-district government involving the Community and the business world located in the village/sub-district in order to promote, protect, - 5 - fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

Article 7

1. The form of Women's Protection services as referred to in Article 6 letter a includes:
a. legal aid;
b. health services;
c. social rehabilitation services;
d. complaint, consultation and counseling services;
e. social reintegration services; and
f. pre-marital guidance services.
2. Pre-marital guidance services as referred to in paragraph (1) letter f, shall be carried out for every Woman who will enter into marriage.
3. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be conducted to provide understanding and knowledge regarding family resilience, health, psychology, religion, social and culture.
4. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.
5. In implementing guidance as referred to in paragraph (4) the Regional Apparatus may involve:
a. related agencies;
b. religious leaders; and
c. customary leaders.
6. Further provisions regarding the procedures for Women's Protection services shall be regulated by a Regent Regulation.

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 31

1. The Regent is obliged to conduct guidance and supervision of the Protection of Women and Children.
2. The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection.

(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training;
d. monitoring and evaluation;
e. reporting.
4. 5. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted with professional and transparent principles.
6. In implementing guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection must report periodically to the Regent.
7. In the case of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatus, the Community, agencies and/or related organizational institutions.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

CONCERNING

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF GUNUNG MAS REGENCY

NUMBER 1 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF GUNUNG MAS REGENCY

NUMBER 1 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

NUMBER 1 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

NUMBER 1 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Gunung Mas Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of Gunung Mas.

4 - 4 . Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.

5. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
6. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from Violence and discrimination.
7. Woman is a person who is female.
8. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb.

9. Community is an individual, community group, including parents and family.

10. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against Women and Children.
11. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA, is a coordination forum for handling victims of Violence against Women and Children which is organized in tiers at the regency and sub-district levels.
13. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower Women in various fields of development, as well as protection of Women and Children from various types of discrimination, and acts of Violence, including trafficking in persons established by the government or community-based.
14. Child-Friendly Village/Sub-District, hereinafter abbreviated as K/DRA, is the development of a village/sub-district area that unites the commitment and resources of the village/sub-district government involving the Community and the business world located in the village/sub-district in order to promote, protect, - 5 - fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

b. conducting education on anti-Violence values against Women and Children; and

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

3. Regent is the Regent of Gunung Mas.

4 - 4 . Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.

5. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
6. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from Violence and discrimination.
7. Woman is a person who is female.
8. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb.

9. Community is an individual, community group, including parents and family.

10. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against Women and Children.
11. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.

13. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower Women in various fields of development, as well as protection of Women and Children from various types of discrimination, and acts of Violence, including trafficking in persons established by the government or community-based.
14. Child-Friendly Village/Sub-District, hereinafter abbreviated as K/DRA, is the development of a village/sub-district area that unites the commitment and resources of the village/sub-district government involving the Community and the business world located in the village/sub-district in order to promote, protect, - 5 - fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower Women in various fields of development, as well as protection of Women and Children from various types of discrimination, and acts of Violence, including trafficking in persons established by the government or community-based.
14. Child-Friendly Village/Sub-District, hereinafter abbreviated as K/DRA, is the development of a village/sub-district area that unites the commitment and resources of the village/sub-district government involving the Community and the business world located in the village/sub-district in order to promote, protect, - 5 - fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Gunung Mas Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of Gunung Mas.

4 - 4 . Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.

5. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
6. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from Violence and discrimination.
7. Woman is a person who is female.
8. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb.

9. Community is an individual, community group, including parents and family.

10. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against Women and Children.
11. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA, is a coordination forum for handling victims of Violence against Women and Children which is organized in tiers at the regency and sub-district levels.
13. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower Women in various fields of development, as well as protection of Women and Children from various types of discrimination, and acts of Violence, including trafficking in persons established by the government or community-based.
14. Child-Friendly Village/Sub-District, hereinafter abbreviated as K/DRA, is the development of a village/sub-district area that unites the commitment and resources of the village/sub-district government involving the Community and the business world located in the village/sub-district in order to promote, protect, - 5 - fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children is organized based on the principles of:
a. respect, fulfillment, protection, promotion, and enforcement of rights; and
b. legal certainty.

OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF GUNUNG MAS REGENCY

NUMBER 1 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise, Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles in obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to be given the widest possible opportunity to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations governing the Protection of Women and Children.

2. In organizing the coordination of Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) the Regent shall establish a coordination team for Protection of Women and Children.
3. In the coordination forum activities as referred to in paragraph (2) the coordination team for Protection of Women and Children shall have the duties to: a. prepare necessary materials related to the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; and b. deliver results, obstacles, and solutions undertaken to overcome obstacles in the implementation of Protection of Women and Children.
4. The coordination forum as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be conducted periodically, at least 2 (two) times in 1 (one) year.

CHAPTER VIII

EVALUATION

Article 32

1. Evaluation of the Protection of Women and Children is conducted based on documents of service implementation, empowerment, Prevention, fulfillment and monitoring results of the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.
2. The implementation of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection.
3. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes process, impact and results evaluation.
4. The results of the evaluation as referred to in paragraph (3) constitute material for the Regional Apparatus to prepare a report which is subsequently submitted to the Regent.
5. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (4) shall be carried out at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.

(6) Further provisions regarding evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

CHAPTER IX

Part Five

Monitoring

Article 7

1. The form of Women's Protection services as referred to in Article 6 letter a includes:
a. legal aid;
b. health services;
c. social rehabilitation services;
d. complaint, consultation and counseling services;
e. social reintegration services; and
f. pre-marital guidance services.
2. Pre-marital guidance services as referred to in paragraph (1) letter f, shall be carried out for every Woman who will enter into marriage.
3. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be conducted to provide understanding and knowledge regarding family resilience, health, psychology, religion, social and culture.
4. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.
5. In implementing guidance as referred to in paragraph (4) the Regional Apparatus may involve:
a. related agencies;
b. religious leaders; and
c. customary leaders.
6. Further provisions regarding the procedures for Women's Protection services shall be regulated by a Regent Regulation.

Article 14

1. Prevention of violations of Children's rights shall be implemented by the Regional Government and the Community.
2. Prevention of violations of Children's rights implemented by the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by:
a. establishing a work network;
b. conducting coordination, integration, synchronization of Prevention based on partnership patterns with the Community, private sector, non-governmental organizations; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to Child Protection.
3. Prevention of violations of Children's rights implemented by the Community as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by:
a. increasing Children's productivity;

b. developing Children's self-potential;
c. preventing pregnancy at a young age;
d. reducing maternal and infant mortality rates; and
e. preventing the occurrence of domestic Violence.
4. Establishment of a work network as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a, includes the Regional Government's work partners in the implementation of Prevention of rights violations in the form of family partners.
5. Further provisions regarding Prevention of violations of Children's rights as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

Part Two

Prevention of Violence Against Women and Children

Paragraph 2

FPK2PA

Article 27

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of Women and Children from acts of Violence, FPK2PA shall be established.
2. FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of:  a. Regional FPK2PA;
b. sub-district FPK2PA; and c. village/ward FPK2PA.
3. The establishment of Regional FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a shall be stipulated by the Regent.
4. The establishment of sub-district FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b shall be stipulated by the sub-district head.
5. The establishment of Village/ward FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be stipulated by the village/ward head. (6) Further provisions regarding FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in Regent Regulation.

CHAPTER VII

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 31

1. The Regent is obliged to conduct guidance and supervision of the Protection of Women and Children.
2. The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection.

(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training;
d. monitoring and evaluation;
e. reporting.
4. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is to realize the objectives of the Protection of Women and Children in accordance with the norms, standards, procedures and criteria implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection.
5. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted with professional and transparent principles.
6. In implementing guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection must report periodically to the Regent.
7. In the case of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children's Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatus, the Community, agencies and/or related organizational institutions.
